project_title: Daily Maintenance Report & PPT Presentation Web App
emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / INDUSTRIAL TACTICAL
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, high-density industrial maintenance daily report management tool in Bahasa Indonesia.
Support 2 distinct shift profiles: Shift 1 (07:00 - 15:00) and Shift 2 (15:00 - 23:00) with instant shift switching, active shift badge, and shift-filtered views.

Implement core CRUD operations for Daily Maintenance Reports with fields: Tanggal, Shift (Shift 1 / Shift 2), Area / Lokasi (e.g., Line Stamping A, CNC Workshop, Utility Boiler, Conveyor Belt #3), Deskripsi Pekerjaan, Status (Selesai / Pending / Dalam Perbaikan / Critical Issue), Upload Multiple Gambar (with image preview, file upload simulator, and gallery viewer), and Catatan / Rekomendasi.

Provide a dedicated PPT Presentation Mode (Mode Slideshow / Serah Terima Shift) that presents reports one-by-one like a PowerPoint deck. Include Next/Previous keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Space), thumbnail drawer, auto-play timer, full-screen toggle, and high-visibility typography for shift handover meetings.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='shift-selector-1', data-testid='btn-presentation-mode', data-testid='report-card-1').
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or floating overlays; always apply solid or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-800).

Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for industrial UI elements: Wrench, HardHat, MonitorPlay, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Clock, Filter, Search, ImagePlus, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, SlidersHorizontal, ArrowRightLeft, FileSpreadsheet.

layout_patterns.header: Sticky navbar with dark slate glassmorphism (bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800), active shift indicator switcher (Shift 1 vs Shift 2), Search bar, New Report button, and PPT Presentation Trigger button.
layout_patterns.kpi_bar: Summary bar at the top displaying total reports today, Selesai count, Pending count, Critical Issue count, and Shift ratio.
layout_patterns.filter_toolbar: Search input, Dropdown filter for Shift (Semua / Shift 1 / Shift 2), Dropdown for Status, Date Picker / Quick Date Range (Hari Ini, 7 Hari, Bulan Ini), Area Filter, View Toggle (Grid Cards vs Compact Table).
layout_patterns.report_grid: Mode B Tetris/High-Density grid layout with crisp slate borders, status pills, area tags, multi-photo thumbnail grid, technician avatar/shift stamp, and instant actions (Detail, Edit, Launch in Presentation).
layout_patterns.presentation_mode: Full-viewport overlay with dark gradient background, high-contrast slide card, left/right floating arrow controls, slide progress bar, thumbnail filmstrip at bottom, full-screen toggle, speaker notes toggle, and print/export summary button.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure the language used throughout the UI is natural Bahasa Indonesia suitable for Indonesian manufacturing/maintenance plants (e.g. Laporan Harian Maintenance, Serah Terima Shift, Modus Presentasi PPT, Deskripsi Pekerjaan, Penanganan Kendala).
Provide realistic pre-populated initial seed reports for both Shift 1 and Shift 2 so the presentation mode and filters work out-of-the-box.
Implement real local storage persistence or state management so new reports and edits persist across refreshes.
Add toast notifications via sonner for actions like 'Laporan Berhasil Disimpan', 'Shift Berhasil Diubah', 'Foto Diunggah'.
Make presentation mode respond smoothly to keyboard navigation (Left/Right Arrow keys) and include a clear Exit button (Esc).
